title: Mori dream Jacobian elliptic surfaces of Kodaira dimension one
summary: Let $π\colon X\to\mathbb P^1$ be a Jacobian elliptic surface over $\mathbb C$, and set $χ=χ(\mathcal O_X)\ge3$, so that $κ(X)=1$. Assume that the Mordell--Weil group of $π$ is finite and that $π$ has at least one reducible fiber, the reducible fibers being of types $I_{n_1},\ldots,I_{n_s}$. We prove that the zero section and the components of the reducible fibers generate the closed Mori cone if and only if \[ \sum_{i=1}^s\frac{\lfloor n_i^2/4\rfloor}{n_i}\leχ. \] If $\sum_i n_i\le2χ+3$, then $X$ is a Mori dream surface. The proof combines an explicit description of the facets of the cone…
